title: Nachemson & Morris 1964: L4-L5 IDP in standing (corrected, via Dreischarf 2016)

quantity.name: IDP
quantity.definition: absolute in vivo IDP in standing; CORRECTED early-transducer value (original - 0.25 MPa, Nachemson's retrospective correction for transducer self-heating) as tabulated by Dreischarf 2016; original value in 'original_mpa'

source.authors: Nachemson A, Morris JM (tabulated by Dreischarf M, Shirazi-Adl A, Arjmand N, Rohlmann A, Schmidt H)
source.journal: J Bone Joint Surg Am 46:1077 / Acta Orthop Scand Suppl 43 (table: J Biomech 49:833-845, 2016)
source.sample: 4 subjects (4M, patients); 4 male patients with low-back pain/sciatica

protocol.summary: Early liquid/piezo needle transducer measurements in standing; values as corrected and tabulated in Dreischarf et al. 2016 review.
how_to_simulate: Scale the model to each subject (protocol.subject_model.per_subject: sex, age, height, weight)
Posture: relaxed upright standing, arms hanging; no hand load
Output: L4-L5 compression F (and flexion th = 0)
Convert with Ghezelbash 2016 Eq. 6 using the subject's L4-L5 disc area (per_subject.disc_area_mm2); compare with data[].mean (corrected)

per_subject.history: compression fracture of L4, 18 yrs intermittent LBP
LBP, left leg and foot pains for 2.5 yrs after a fall
LBP 2 mo, back to work 3 w after discharge

protocol.idp_conversion: IDP = -1.556e-2 + 1.255 P + 1.243e-2 th + 3.988e-2 P^2 - 1.212e-2 P th + 1.669e-3 th^2 (MPa), P = F_compression / A_disc (MPa = N/mm2), th = L4-L5 intersegmental flexion from upright standing (deg, + flexion). Source: Ghezelbash et al. 2016 Biomech Model Mechanobiol 15:1699, Eq. 6 (U01 p.10; quadratic fit to the Shirazi-Adl 2006 L4-L5 FE model, R2 0.999, RMSE 0.025 MPa; derived with that model's disc area 1455 mm2, applied with the subject's own area); used again as Eq. 1-2 in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 J Biomech 102:109550 and in the Ghezelbash lab MSK validation. Sensitivity alternative: classical Nachemson factor IDP = F / (0.66 A) (Bruno et al. 2015 J Biomech Eng Eq. 2; Dreischarf 2016 V05 uses F = 0.66 IDP A).
protocol.notes: Patients (LBP), not healthy. Early transducer: use corrected values; do not pool with modern measurements (Wilke, Sato, Takahashi).

extraction.from: Dreischarf 2016 J Biomech 49:833 (V05) Table 2 p.836 (page image)
extraction.uncertainty: values as printed (2 decimals); correction of -0.25 MPa (range 0.2-0.3) is itself uncertain
extraction.check_notes: Each row compared against the rendered table image; compressive forces reproduce 0.66 x IDP x area. | verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (V05 Dreischarf 2016 L4-L5 standing table p.836: 0.61(0.86), 0.59(0.84), 0.67(0.92), 0.34(0.59); forces 720/846/913/442)

pass_rule.rule: pass if |model - measured| <= max(SD or half-range, 0.26 x measured); pooled over all L4-L5 tasks R2 >= 0.78 with slope 95% CI containing 1 and intercept CI containing 0
pass_rule.source: Ghezelbash lab validation targets tolerance_policy.idp_task / idp_aggregate (CV_pool 0.26 = pooled between-subject CV of Sato 1999's 8 healthy subjects)
